Subject: You've got a trip to plan — 20% off ends Sunday
Preview: The Ridgeline 2P is back in stock. Your discount runs out this weekend.
Body: It's been a while. If you've got a trip on the calendar — or one you've been putting off — here's a practical reason to move on it.

The Northbay Ridgeline 2P Tent (NB-TNT-02) is currently available, and for the next few days you can take 20% off.

A few straight facts about it:

• 2-person capacity, 3-season rating — built for spring through fall conditions. Not designed for winter mountaineering or sustained snow load.
• 2.1 kg packed weight — manageable for a two-night backpacking stretch without dominating your pack.
• Ripstop nylon construction — holds up to regular trail use and keeps weight down.

Nothing flashy. Just a shelter that does its job so you can focus on the route.

20% off ends Sunday. Stock is available now.
